name: school
description: Students, teachers, courses and enrollments with a unique pair and a bounded grade.

input.requirements: A school registry. Students have a full_name, a unique email and an enrolled_on date. Teachers have a full_name and a unique email. Courses have a unique code, a title and credits (more than 0); each course may have one teacher, and if a teacher is deleted the course stays without one. Students enroll in courses; an enrollment records the student, the course and an optional grade from 0 to 100. A student can enroll in a course only once.
